summary: The hook adds the stat-eyebrow rule to prompts that ask for design work before a layout is chosen.
doc: This UserPromptSubmit hook adds the stat-eyebrow rule to the model's context when the prompt mentions design work, such as a layout, cover, card, slide, deck, thumbnail, dashboard or chart. The rule prohibits generating, proposing or listing a card where a giant number is the dominant type beside a small all-caps tracked label, and requires a sentence instead. The hook pairs with no-stat-eyebrow, which blocks the card when it is written. The hook never blocks anything and stays silent when the prompt contains no design words.
